title: fix(service-print, spec): the print door's 5xx sentences follow the request's language
body:
Fixes #37260

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在中文(以及日文、西班牙文)界面里点击打印，若服务器上的打印引擎未就绪、打印超时或服务器出错，提示条现在用界面语言显示；英文界面与以前一字不差。
- 为什么做：报价单打印失败时中文界面弹出整句英文，看起来像坏了，业务用户也看不懂；这是该缺陷卡(打印失败提示不跟随界面语言)本身。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某种语言的提示措辞不够好，状态码与错误码都不变，不影响打印本身；可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: four keys in the platform's operation-message catalog (`BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES`), in all four locales it carries (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`): `print_engine_unavailable` (503), `print_timed_out` (504), `print_failed` (the 5xx fallback) and `print_caller_unresolved` (the door's caller-resolution 500). English is byte-identical to the fixed text the door answered before. No placeholder; the header documents them beside the other keys.
- `packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.ts`: `serverAnswerFor(status, locale)` maps the status to its catalog key and renders it through `operationUserMessage` (`@objectstack/core`), the shared helper the platform's other localized refusals use; `relayPrintFailure` and the caller-resolution fault pass the request's top `Accept-Language` tag (`preferredLocaleFromHeader`). The door reads no query parameter, so `?locale` is not a source. Code, status, the fault log and the 4xx relay are unchanged.
- `packages/services/service-print/vitest.config.ts`: aliases `@objectstack/spec/system` to source like the other spec subpaths, so the new import is judged against this checkout, never a stale `dist/`.

The mechanism reused, not a new one: the operation-message catalog plus `operationUserMessage` is the platform's one seat for localized user-facing server sentences (its header: "a second mechanism for the second producer is exactly what this module exists to prevent"). The door's `message` itself is localized, because `sendServerFault`'s `message` is already the route's generic user-facing text (the thrown detail goes only to the fault log) and `sendServerFault` declares no `userMessage` channel; widening it would change an `@objectstack/types` export outside this card's file surface.

The action path from the repro (`POST /api/v1/actions/crm_quote/print_quote`) produces no sentence of its own for these failures: the `/actions` door forwards a same-origin `type: 'api'` action in-process with `accept-language` on its header allowlist (`API_FORWARD_HEADER_ALLOWLIST`, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) and relays the target's refusal envelope with its `message` as written (`restAnswerOf`, `forward-refused`, `packages/runtime/src/action-dispatch.ts`). So fixing the door fixes the action toast; nothing changed in `packages/runtime`.

Bounded in-place fix, declared: the caller-resolution 500 (`The caller of this print could not be resolved.`) is the same door's own 5xx sentence, the same defect class, the same file in the claim's surface, the same gate family; it is localized the same way and pinned below.

### Read first

1. `packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.ts` (the `requestLocaleOf` / `serverAnswerKeyFor` / `serverAnswerFor` hunk) — the only behaviour change.
2. `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts` — the 16 new catalog strings; the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES wording is the review risk.
3. `packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.test.ts` — the new top-level `describe`.

### Two-minute verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/print-routes.test.ts` — expect 36 passed, including ten under "its own 5xx sentences, in the request's language".

## Acceptance notes

- The language source is the request's `Accept-Language` only. The door's execution context carries no locale and no workspace default (`requestLocale: undefined`, `localization: undefined`), so `operationUserMessage`'s second rung (the workspace default) has nothing to read here; the console sends its UI language on every call, which is the issue's case.
- No deployment `errors.print_*` translation override is consulted: `operationUserMessage` is the helper for producers that hold no i18n service, and the door holds none.
- The door's own 4xx refusals (the impersonation refusal, the request-shape refusals) stay English developer text; they are outside this card, which names the 5xx sentences.
- Observation only, not filed: the `/actions` door's own forward-unavailable sentence (`apiActionForwardUnavailableError`, 503) and the print bridge's `501` are English too; neither is on this card's path when the door is mounted, and neither was reproduced here.
- Clause-② measured: no new export, no type change, no new envelope field, no new input read as a contract (any header was already accepted); the catalog gains entries in an existing exported `Record` value, and the wire `message` changes language only for a non-English request.
